author: Dyspa
body:
- Many people have complained about the Block Glitch while you make a bridge, well, I found a solution that's has a 90% of efficiency, so, here it is.

- Its pretty simple, just make a staircase, it almost doesn't glitch and has helped me a lot while in game.

- That's it, I just wanted to help cause many people rage with this, hope you fix this anyways, bye! :D
